step1_figure.description: A three-stage CMOS ring oscillator with an explicit 10fF load capacitance on one of the nodes. It generates a continuous periodic waveform whose frequency is determined by the sum of the propagation delays of the three inverter stages.

oscillation_frequency.description: The fundamental frequency at which the ring oscillator toggles.

equation.explanation: N is the number of stages (3), and t_d is the average propagation delay per stage.
equation.assumptions: Assumes identical stages or uses the average delay. Here, one stage has an explicit 10fF load, making its delay dominant.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Frequency is highly dependent on the chosen W/L parameters and extracted parasitic capacitances. The 10fF load significantly lowers the frequency compared to an unloaded ring.

power_consumption.description: Average dynamic power dissipated by the oscillator.

equation.formula: P_avg = N * C_avg * VDD^2 * f_osc + P_short_circuit
equation.explanation: Power is dominated by the dynamic charging and discharging of the node capacitances at the oscillation frequency.
equation.assumptions: Short-circuit power is negligible compared to dynamic power.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total capacitance switching per cycle C_tot = C_N0 + C_N1 + C_N2 = 15fF + 5fF + 5fF = 25fF. P_avg = 25fF * (1.8V)^2 * 26.1GHz = 2.11 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales linearly with the oscillation frequency and total node capacitance.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the oscillating nodes.

equation.explanation: The difference between the maximum high voltage and minimum low voltage reached during oscillation.
equation.assumptions: The frequency is low enough relative to the stage bandwidth to allow full rail-to-rail swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMOS inverters pull fully to VDD and GND. V_OH = 1.8V, V_OL = 0V. V_swing = 1.8V - 0V = 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At very high frequencies, the swing might attenuate slightly before reaching the rails, but typically it achieves near 1.8V.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure oscillation frequency, average power consumption, and output voltage swing of the 3-stage ring oscillator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 3-Stage Ring Oscillator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Define parameters for the parameterized netlist
.param L_XMP0=0.15 W_XMP0=2.0
.param L_XMN0=0.15 W_XMN0=1.0
.param L_XMP1=0.15 W_XMP1=2.0
.param L_XMN1=0.15 W_XMN1=1.0
.param L_XMP2=0.15 W_XMP2=2.0
.param L_XMN2=0.15 W_XMN2=1.0

* DUT Netlist
XMP0 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_XMP0} w={W_XMP0}
XMN0 N1 N0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_XMN0} w={W_XMN0}

XMP1 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_XMP1} w={W_XMP1}
XMN1 N2 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_XMN1} w={W_XMN1}

XMP2 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_XMP2} w={W_XMP2}
XMN2 N0 N2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_XMN2} w={W_XMN2}

CL N0 0 10f
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N0)=0 v(N1)=1.8 v(N2)=0

.options savecurrents

.control
* Run transient analysis for 20ns to allow settling
tran 10p 20n

* Measure Oscillation Frequency
meas tran t_period trig v(N0) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=11
let f_osc = 1 / t_period
print f_osc

* Measure Average Power Consumption (integrate current from 10ns to 20ns)
meas tran pwr_integ integ i(VDD) from=10n to=20n
let pwr_avg = - (pwr_integ / 10n) * 1.8
print pwr_avg

* Measure Output Swing
meas tran vmax max v(N0) from=10n to=20n
meas tran vmin min v(N0) from=10n to=20n
let vswing = vmax - vmin
print vswing

quit
.endc
.end
